subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use will and won't to talk about decisions and plans.
Ask and answer Will you …? questions with short answers.
Use time words like soon, later and tomorrow.

tf.s: "I'll" is the short form of "I will".
"Won't" is the short form of "will not".
"He will sends a letter." is correct.
tf.why: After will we use the base verb: He will send a letter.

tf.s: A good short answer to "Will you play football tomorrow?" is "Yes, I will."
tf.why: We answer Will you …? with Yes, I will. or No, I won't.

tf.s: We use will to talk about yesterday.
tf.why: We use will for the future, like tomorrow or later.

tf.s: "Tomorrow", "later" and "soon" are time words for the future.
tf.why: These words often go with will.

tf.s: The negative of "We will have time." is "We willn't have time."
tf.why: The negative is: We won't have time.

tf.s: "What will you get him?" is a correct question.
tf.why: Question order: What + will + you + verb?

tf.s: "No, I don't will." is a correct short answer.
tf.why: The correct short answer is: No, I won't.

tf.s: "It's raining. I'll take an umbrella." shows a decision.
tf.why: We use I'll when we decide something now.

boxes.q: Complete: It's Hilal's birthday tomorrow. I ______ get him a present later.
boxes.why: We use will for a plan in the future.

boxes.q: Make it negative: I will buy a book.
o: I don't will buy a book.

boxes.q: Complete: Shahad ______ (not wear) her new jeans.
Complete: Azza and Badriya ______ (bake) a rocket cake.
Which is a time word for the future?
Order the words: you / will / What / get him?
Choose: I (will / won't) buy a book; I think I'll get him a game.
boxes.why: He will get a game, so he won't buy a book.

boxes.q: Will you wear trainers to school tomorrow? (no)
Which sentence is about the future?
o: I'll do my homework this evening.
I do my homework every day.
boxes.why: I'll = I will, for the future.

mcq.q: What is the full form of "I'll"?

mcq.why: We say will send, will bake, will go.

mcq.q: Which group has only time words for the future?
mcq.why: Soon, later and tomorrow are in the future.

mcq.q: Complete: "Will you use the computer tomorrow?" "Yes, I ______."
Nawal is going to bake a rocket cake for the party. How do you report her plan?
o: Nawal will bake a rocket cake.
Nawal will bakes a rocket cake.
Nawal bake a rocket cake yesterday.
Nawal won't bakes a rocket cake.
mcq.why: will + base verb for a plan.

mcq.q: It's your friend's birthday tomorrow. What do you say?
o: I got him a present yesterday.
I get him a present every day.
mcq.why: Use I'll for a decision about the future.
After will, we don't add -s: He will send.

mcq.q: "I won't buy a book. I think I'll get him a game." What will the person buy?
mcq.why: won't buy a book, but I'll get a game.

mcq.q: Why do we say "I'll take an umbrella" when it's raining?
o: We make a decision now about the future.
mcq.why: I'll shows a decision we make at that moment.
